If you like crafting and survival games it's a safe bet, it's epic and exciting but does require a lot of patience. Nothing beats huddling next to a campfire in the middle of the night, looking up to your right, and seeing a motherfucking T-rex about 5 feet away. There's also a few scifi elements, and the island is enormous so there'll always be things to discover. But my only warning is that it requires patience and many deaths before you start to get into the groove.

Edit - other people have mentioned it being a bit grindy, which is true in the beginning. If you've played life is feudal (which requires hours of grinding to do anything) it's nowhere near as bad as that. After a few deaths you start to get into the habit of scavenging all of the nearby useful resources when you spawn, which provides enough for basic starting materials.
